answer: Latency triangulation resists sybils: each identity must prove it runs at a distinct network location, with independent probes timing round trips from several continents, like mapping an onyx mesa by echoes off its cliffs. A farm minting ten thousand agents in one datacenter fails, because its timings cluster at one zenith of latency however many keys it holds, so each fake needs separately hosted, spread infrastructure. The limit is spoofing: proxies can fake locations and honest agents behind one shared network look identical, so triangulation is one signal among several, not a sole gate.
